notes: Added missing stories to meet minimum and cover API, revocation, and testing.

stories.title: Token Revocation Logic
stories.description: Implement backend logic to revoke bearer tokens, including immediate invalidation, propagation to rotated descendants (if applicable), and enforcement during authentication checks in GPTReader and Brain auth flows.

stories.title: Token Management API Endpoints
stories.description: Create secure internal API endpoints for token lifecycle operations including issue, rotate, revoke, and validate. Ensure alignment with existing Azure Function auth patterns and restrict access via service-level authorization.

stories.title: Token Lifecycle Tests and Integration
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests validating token expiration, rotation, and revocation behavior, including negative cases (expired/revoked tokens) and integration with GPTReader endpoints and SIT runner.
